title: KCS U3c (d) RUN: the 3e10 and 1e11 points of the residual law - the out-of-sample test of the sole surviving form (the 2-param mixed R = a*delta + b*(loglog/log)^2 with a, b anchored on 1e7..1e9 BEFORE 1e10 existed in the record). New points (exact U3b-family byte sieve; the interval mechanism gated by an exact identity check against the global sieve at 1e10): 3e10 meas = 0.544733 (pi 1300005926, se 1.38e-05), R = +0.003971 (z = 287.5 vs u3-only); 1e11 meas = 0.542888 (pi 4118054813 = the tabulated pi(10^11), se 7.76e-06), R = +0.003654 (z = 470.7 vs u3-only). VERDICT (supersedes the 0186 verdict line): the 4-point-anchored mixed form systematically UNDER-predicts R at all three out-of-sample points - predicted +0.003639/+0.003139/+0.002655 vs measured +0.004307/+0.003971/+0.003654 at 1e10/3e10/1e11 - and the positive excess grows with X: +6.68e-04 -> +8.32e-04 -> +9.99e-04 (28.6/60.3/128.7 measurement se against each point). The 5-point refit undershoots by a smaller but same-signed amount (+4.36e-04/+5.62e-04). Per-decade R decay ratios over the full 7-point ladder = 0.6853/0.8413/0.8246/0.8337/0.8435/0.8529 (stabilizing at ~0.83-0.85/decade and creeping UP). No tested form is confirmed as THE residual law; the new named target: R(X) = (a decaying component of the tested forms) + (a slowly GROWING positive excess, ~1.4-1.6x/decade over the short 2-point range - suggestive, not a law). The strict gate remains OPEN (now 470.7 se against u3-only at 1e11). No RH claim: prime-gap class statistic over the exact byte sieve; flank, not face.
claim: This is U3c plan item (a) follow-up named in 0186 (the 3e10/1e11 points where the mixed form predicts R = +0.003139 / +0.002655), run as a clean out-of-sample test: the prediction was anchored on 1e7..1e9 BEFORE the 1e10 point existed in the record, and 1e10 itself is re-printed in the same run as the first out-of-sample check (it reproduces 0186's measured +0.004307). Ground truth: (1) 3e10 uses the VERBATIM U3b global byte sieve (80 s); (2) 1e11 is too large for a single in-memory byte array at this box's standing memory rules (a full 1e11 pass would need ~185 GB against a 108 GB usable ceiling), so a verbatim-marking INTERVAL variant is used - the same odd-indexed boolean array over [X_lo, X_hi], marked by every small prime p <= sqrt(X_hi) with the identical start/step rule, so the primes extracted are byte-identical to the global sieve's; the interval mechanism is gated by an identity check against the global sieve at 1e10 (pi AND class census reproduced exactly - plus a pre-run smoke identity at 1e9 and 3e9); (3) pi(1e11) = 4,118,054,813 agrees with the tabulated prime count at 10^11 (independent identity; H1 pi 2,119,654,578 + H2 pi 1,998,400,235 = 4,118,054,813 exactly, and the merged gap count equals npr - 1 by assertion). The statistics: per-decade R decay ratios over the full ladder 1e7..1e11 = 0.6853/0.8413/0.8246/0.8337/0.8435/0.8529 - the decay stabilizes near 0.83-0.85/decade and creeps slightly UP over the last two intervals; the excess of measured R over the 4-point-anchored mixed prediction is positive at all three out-of-sample points and grows: +6.68e-04 (1e10), +8.32e-04 (3e10), +9.99e-04 (1e11) - per-decade growth of the excess ~1.4-1.6x over the short 2-interval range (two points of growth - SUGGESTIVE, explicitly not a law). Honest reading (superseding the 0186 'predicts within 1.2 sigma' verdict line, which was the state before 3e10/1e11 existed): none of the tested residual-law forms (the (loglog/log)^2 scaling form A, the alpha-power-law form B, the 2-param mixed form C) is confirmed as THE law; C remains the best of the tested forms (its misses are the smallest and its 1e10 deviation was 1.2 sigma of its own 4-point prediction uncertainty), but the systematic positive excess with a slowly growing magnitude is the new named structure. The residual law is refined (all complete-form claims at the tested shapes are off; the excess component is real at 28.6-128.7 measurement se), not closed. Reachability: 1e11 is this machine's ceiling under the standing memory rules (two 5e10 halves, peak RSS 92.7 GB, 103 GB free after); 3e11/1e12 would need 150 GB+ single passes or a new bit/segmented ground truth - named as out of reach here, NOT as a blocker (the flank). Cost: 449.6 s total wall, 1 core, peak 92.7 GB. No RH claim: the unit is a prime-gap class census over exact integers (the zeta-side inputs enter only as named model channels delta(x) and the w-sum from the U3 machinery).
evidence: scripts/rh/kcs3c_d_next_decade.py: the U3b/measured() machinery verbatim + the interval variant (measured_interval, small_primes, merge_two_intervals) with the identity-assert gate; the 4-point-anchored out-of-sample test; the 5-point refit printed as reference-only (NOT the test)
